module: "Vehicle Spawn" debug tool: adds a point-of-interest marker to the 'debugParking' parking of west_coast_usa (facilities.sites.json) whose detail window offers to spawn a 'rented' vehicle or trailer (sunburst/race_M, boxutility/loaded_200), optionally added to the inventory (owned = false). spawnVehicle chains fade to black, spawn, initPartConditions, wait, then fade back in via util_stepHandler.
notes: The path /levels/west_coast_usa/facilities.sites.json is hardcoded: the tool only works on this map.
buttonPressed calls buttonOptions[i], a table that is never filled in this file (the buttons go through luaCallback).

onGetRawPoiListForLevel.desc: POI list hook: if the 'debugParking' parking is loaded, adds a 'debugVehicleSpawn' element with a parking marker (path, pos, rot, scl).

drawDebugMenu.desc: On the first frame loads the west_coast_usa sites and gets 'debugParking'; draws the 'Vehicle Spawn' window with a 'Spawn and rent a vehicle' button (sunburst/race_M, added to the inventory).

spawnVehicle.desc: Spawns a vehicle with a fade to black, initializes its part conditions, waits for the vehicle's response (ping) then fades back in; if addToInventory is true, adds it to the inventory with owned = false.

addToInventory.desc: Adds the vehicle to the inventory (not owned).

buttonPressed.desc: Runs buttonOptions[i](); this table is never filled in the module.

onPoiDetailPromptOpening.desc: Hook: if the element is 'debugVehicleSpawn', adds to promptData an 'Open Debug Menu' button that shows a dialog (guihooks 'showConfirmationDialog') with three spawn choices.
